question: The Wadali Brothers are _________ singers.
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Sufi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The renowned **Wadali Brothers**, comprising **Ustad Puran Chand Wadali and Pyarelal Wadali,** are celebrated Sufi singers hailing from the village of **"Guru Ki Wadali"** near Amritsar city in Punjab.
 
• They have garnered global acclaim for their mesmerizing performances in various genres of music, including Gurbani, Kafi, Ghazal, and Bhajan.
